title: Fast Test-Time Refinement for Robust Learned Image Compression
abstract: arXiv:2608.15113v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learned image compression (LIC) has demonstrated remarkable rate-distortion (RD) performance in benign settings. However, the high representational capacity endowed by deep neural networks (DNNs) comes at the expense of increased adversarial vulnerability. This hinders their adoption as trusted standardized codecs. Recent work has sketched test-time refinement (TTR) as a defense in gray-box scenarios, despite its original purpose of improving benign RD performance. Unfortunately, extensive iterations of TTR incur prohibitive overhead, while the robustness mechanism lacks theoretical understanding. Moreover, TTR has not been evaluated in white-box settings or against attacks beyond $\ell_2$-bounded rate and untargeted distortion objectives. To bridge these gaps, we present a systematic study. translated_title: 快速测试时细化用于鲁棒学习图像压缩
translated_abstract: 学习图像压缩（LIC）在良性环境下已展现出显著的率失真（RD）性能。然而，深度神经网络（DNN）赋予的高表示能力以增加对抗性脆弱性为代价。这阻碍了它们作为可信标准化编解码器的采用。近期工作将测试时细化（TTR）作为灰盒场景中的防御手段，尽管其初衷是改善良性RD性能。不幸的是，TTR的多次迭代会产生过高的开销，而其鲁棒性机制缺乏理论理解。此外，TTR尚未在白盒设置或针对超出$\ell_2$有界速率和非目标失真目标的攻击下进行评估。为弥补这些空白，我们进行了系统性研究。我们的研究揭示了LIC系统中的不对称对抗轨迹（AAT）特性：从对抗区域过渡到良性区域是显著的...
tldr: 本研究系统分析了学习图像压缩中的测试时细化防御，发现不对称对抗轨迹特性，并提出快速细化方法以在降低开销的同时增强白盒和多种攻击下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This study systematically analyzes test-time refinement defense in learned image compression, reveals an asymmetric adversarial trajectory property, and proposes fast refinement to enhance robustness under white-box and diverse attacks with reduced overhead.
